text: There's one train still on the line, an ammunition run nobody stopped. The signal's at danger. Pull the lever by the goods shed and she'll come in.
Hear that? Rails are cold. Nothing moves tonight but them.
Keep off the line. Old habit.
Thirty-one years on this yard. The last train I let in, I wish I'd sent back.
Lead boxes from the coast. Heavy as sin. They hummed in the cold.
Signal's off. She comes in when she comes. I'll see the crates get to you.
There she is. A crate off the second wagon, in the yard. Take it.
